title: Agent Invocation Log
description: Structured log entry written by an agent after completing its task. One JSON object per invocation, appended to a dated log file.

agent.description: Name of the agent that produced this log (matches filename without .md)

mode.description: Operational mode if agent supports more than one (e.g. 'pr-audit', 'deep-review')

session_id.description: Unique identifier for this invocation session

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the log was written

skills_loaded.description: List of skills loaded during this invocation

inputs.description: Which inputs were available during this invocation

category.description: Skill or check category that produced this finding

actionable.description: Whether this finding requires a specific action to resolve

manual_review_needed.description: Whether this finding requires human judgment to resolve

blockers.description: Number of CRITICAL or blocking findings

duration_seconds.description: Approximate wall-clock duration of the invocation
